Are you technically minded, precise, and motivated by building complex technical products? For ASML in Veldhoven, we are looking for multiple Assemblers who want to work on some of the most advanced technology in the world. As an Assembler, you will be responsible for accurately assembling, testing, and manufacturing complex modules and components. You will work according to technical drawings, work instructions, and established quality standards, with quality and precision always being your top priorities. You will work in a clean, high-tech production environment where precision, teamwork, and continuous improvement are key. It is an environment where your technical skills directly contribute to the quality and reliability of the products. Wie zoeken we? You are someone who works carefully and with a high level of concentration and enjoys assembling technical products. You have a strong eye for detail and understand that even the smallest deviation can be important when working with complex high-tech products. You are also a true team player. You communicate clearly, are open to feedback, and are willing to support your colleagues when needed. You take ownership of your work and do not hesitate to act when you identify a problem. You are eager to learn and motivated to further develop your technical skills within a high-tech environment. Because you may work with different products and activities, you are flexible and able to switch easily between tasks. What you bring MBO Level 3 or 4, preferably in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical field. Experience in a technical production or assembly environment. Experience assembling and testing electronic and/or mechatronic components. Experience working with hand tools such as torque wrenches, pliers, and precision tools. Ability to work with technical drawings and work instructions. Basic knowledge of electrical principles, such as resistance, induction, and

high-voltage testing, is an advantage. Good command of the English language, both written and spoken. Conversational command of the Dutch language is an advantage. Experience working in a cleanroom or contamination-controlled environment is an advantage. Excellent fine motor skills and the ability to work with a high level of precision. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will have the opportunity to work in one of the most innovative high-tech manufacturing environments in the world. You will receive an extensive onboarding program and the necessary training and guidance to become familiar with the work, products, and processes. In addition, we offer: A full-time position of 40 hours per week. A temporary assignment of 12 months. A day shift position. A gross monthly salary of up to €3,400, excluding bonus and holiday allowance. 27 days of paid annual leave. 13 ADV (working time reduction) days. A 13th-month salary, paid annually. An annual bonus based on the company's results. Extensive onboarding, training, and opportunities for further development. The opportunity to work in an international and highly innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines are used to produce the chips that form the foundation of virtually all modern technology. From smartphones and computers to cars and medical equipment, ASML's technology plays an important role in our everyday lives. As an Assembler, you are part of that impact. With your precision and craftsmanship, you ensure that complex modules are assembled and tested according to the highest quality standards. Every module you assemble contributes to the technology that enables the future of the semiconductor industry. Your work. Your craftsmanship. Your contribution to the technology of tomorrow. As a part-time mail carrier for PostNL in Vierlingsbeek, you ensure that everyone receives their mail on time. You have the freedom to organize your own schedule, making this a highly flexible job.

Your day starts at the depot on Vrijthof, where you collect the mail for your delivery route. You sort the letters and hop on your bike. Then you're ready to head out! You cycle through the streets of your area, delivering mail to the correct addresses. Along the way, you can enjoy the fresh air and have a chat with the people you meet.

We currently have two vacancies in Vierlingsbeek, both for 3 hours per day:

- One position is for Fridays and Saturdays, totaling 6 hours per week.
- The other position is from Tuesday through Saturday, totaling 15 hours per week.

The mail is usually available for collection from around 10:00 AM, but you can decide for yourself when to start, as long as all mail is delivered before 6:00 PM. This gives you the flexibility to plan your workday in a way that suits you best.

Are you 16 years or older, do you speak Dutch or English, and do you enjoy being outdoors? Then apply now and start delivering letters and cards in one of our neighborhoods in the region soon! 

Anyone aged 16 or older can become a mail carrier. You understand that you are the face of the postal company, so you work accurately and provide excellent customer service. You enjoy being outdoors and staying active. As a mail carrier, you like being on the move and take pride in making people happy by delivering their mail.

What you need:

- A smartphone that you can use during work for communication and route planning
- A sturdy bicycle with a metal luggage rack
- Availability for 3 hours per day, either in the morning or afternoon
- Flexibility to agree on a suitable work schedule together with your supervisor or team

If you enjoy working independently, spending time outdoors, and staying active, this could be the perfect job for you!

Your responsibilities

As a technical assistant, you’ll be repairing mobile phones. This means you’ll be working with very small parts, so it’s important that you work with precision. You don’t need any previous experience in repair work. We think it’s more important that you’re interested in technology, are comfortable working with computers and phones, and are keen to learn.

Specifically, you’ll be:

    - Repairing mobile phones and other electronic devices 
    
- Replacing parts in accordance with work instructions 
    
- Carrying out checks after repairs 
    
- Recording work in computer systems 
    
- Working in accordance with quality and safety guidelines 
    
- Handling small and fragile parts with care
